tools.name: create_paste
tools.description: Store UTF-8 text at xi.pe and get back a short URL anyone can read. Use it when text has to leave the conversation: someone asks for a shareable link to text you already have -- 'share this', 'give me a URL for it'; something a human needs to read would flood the chat inline -- a long diff, a stack

tools.name: delete_paste
tools.description: Delete a xi.pe paste before it expires. Requires the delete_token returned when it was created; there is no other way to prove ownership.

tools.name: read_paste
tools.description: Fetch the text of an existing xi.pe paste -- including one a user or another agent just handed you. Accepts either the code or the full URL. If you pass the URL on to a human and the text is Markdown, append ?md: it renders headings, tables and ```mermaid diagrams.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "read_paste" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_paste, read_paste · Public sink: create_paste · Destructive: create_paste, delete_paste.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_paste, read_paste · Public sink: create_paste · Destructive: create_paste, delete_paste

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "read_paste" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fetch the text of an existing xi.pe paste -- including one a user or another agent just handed you. Accepts either the code or the full URL." → after: "Fetch the text of an existing xi.pe paste -- including one a user or another agent just handed you. Accepts either the code or the full URL. If you pass the URL on to a human and the text is Markdown, append ?md: it renders headings, tables and ```mermaid diagrams."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
